searchText: Good morning. I wrote a more in-depth annotated spec for the validator client: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/epbs-annotated-validator Thanks to potuz for the review so far. I am looking for feedback or anyone that plans to implement the validator client for ePBS. Please take a look. Thank you. For ePBS builders are the CL teams considering adding builder functionality to their codebases or do we imagine builders will develop their own codebases? Or perhaps both? (I’m specifically referring to builders publishing over p2p) I am planning to reuse the builder spec And API Clients will support this directly There are minor changes The El will need to implement the server side for the builder to sign as well This isn't yet specified but it's trivial I'm not sure I fully understand the question. It seems to be more about whether clients plan to implement a builder than whether we plan to support proposer requesting from a builder out of band. From a solo validator's perspective, I think we should support it. I don't think we'll implement an actual builder client. Supporting it from a solo validator's perspective, as potuz mentioned, is straightforward: - Retrieve the payload from the local EL client and convert it into a header. - Insert the header into the block body, sign it, and broadcast the beacon block. - Broadcast the payload immediately after the block.
